en: Vintage monochrome illustrated postcard showing a street scene with a prominent inn or guesthouse complex. On the left a curved road with sidewalks leads past several houses. Near the center is a multi‑storey building labeled as an inn, with horse‑drawn carriage and early automobile in front, plus two cyclists and a dog on the street. To the right stands a larger hall‑like building with ornate façade and high windows, and further right a tall factory-style chimney within a fenced compound. The text at the top identifies the inn and its owner in German.
